title: 1774. Closest Dessert Cost

examples.explanation: Consider the following combination (all 0-indexed): - Choose base 1: cost 7 - Take 1 of topping 0: cost 1 x 3 = 3 - Take 0 of topping 1: cost 0 x 4 = 0 Total: 7 + 3 + 0 = 10.

Consider the following combination (all 0-indexed): - Choose base 1: cost 3 - Take 1 of topping 0: cost 1 x 4 = 4 - Take 2 of topping 1: cost 2 x 5 = 10 - Take 0 of topping 2: cost 0 x 100 = 0 Total: 3 + 4 + 10 + 0 = 17. You cannot make a dessert with a total cost of 18.
It is possible to make desserts with cost 8 and 10. Return 8 as it is the lower cost.
